Hero.title: Predicting mental state. With evidence.
Hero.subtitle: Dzvin.co is more than analytics. We predict your future mental state, simulate scenarios, and measure our own effectiveness through real outcomes.

interactivity.title: State Prediction
interactivity.subtitle: The system analyzes your behavioral patterns and builds a trajectory of your future state — not just what's happening now, but what comes next.

support.title: Evidence-Backed
support.subtitle: Every recommendation is supported by cohort data — we show what actually worked for people with similar patterns.

ai.title: Explainable AI
ai.subtitle: You know exactly why the system gives a specific recommendation and see clear actions to change your mental state.

Services.title:
From data to predictions
and verified decisions

intro.text: We've moved beyond analytics. Dzvin.co is a prediction and evidence platform that forecasts, validates, and proves its conclusions.

predictionEngine.title: Prediction Engine
predictionEngine.text: A unified prediction core analyzes your data, builds a state trajectory, and models what changes under different actions.

scenarioSimulation.title: Scenario Simulation
scenarioSimulation.text: See the impact of different decisions on your mental state before you make them.

cohortEvidence.title: Cohort-Based Evidence
cohortEvidence.text: Comparison with cohorts of people with similar patterns provides context and confirms the effectiveness of recommendations.

steps.register: Get started — fill in a short questionnaire. Takes a few minutes, and your profile is ready.
steps.choose: Learn about your state — the system shows what's happening now and what might change.
steps.receive: See what works — after each step we check the result and refine the next prediction.

ReduceStress.title: You are not alone in your pattern
ReduceStress.subtitle: Thousands of people with similar behavioral profiles have been through this. Dzvin.co shows which actions actually helped — and how likely they are to help you.
